parameters.name: NeighborMACAddress
parameters.description: The MAC address of an interface in a neighbor 1905 device as defined in {{bibref|IEEE1905.1a|Table 6-17: 1905 transmitter link metric TLV or Table 6-19: 1905 receiver link metric TLV}}.

parameters.name: IEEE802dot1Bridge
parameters.description: Indicates whether or not the 1905 link includes one or more IEEE 802.1 bridges. If {{false}}, the 1905 link does not include an IEEE 802.1 bridge. If {{true}}, the 1905 link does include one or more IEEE 802.1 bridges.

parameters.name: PacketErrors
parameters.description: Estimated number of lost {{units}} on the transmit side of the link {{bibref|IEEE1905.1a|Table 6-18: 1905 transmitter link metrics}} during a measurement period.

parameters.name: PacketErrorsReceived
parameters.description: Estimated number of lost {{units}} on the receive side of the link {{bibref|IEEE1905.1a|Table 6-20: 1905 receiver link metrics}} during a measurement period.

parameters.name: TransmittedPackets
parameters.description: Estimated number of {{units}} sent to the Neighbor on this link, in the same measurement period used to estimate {{param|PacketErrors}}.

parameters.name: PacketsReceived
parameters.description: Estimated number of {{units}} received from this Neighbor {{bibref|IEEE1905.1a|Table 6-20: 1905 receiver link metrics}} on this link, in the same measurement period used to estimate {{param|PacketErrors}}.

parameters.name: MACThroughputCapacity
parameters.description: The maximum MAC throughput in {{units}} between this Interface and the Neighbor on this link that is estimated at this Interface.

parameters.name: LinkAvailability
parameters.description: The estimated average {{units}} of time that this link is idle.

parameters.name: PHYRate
parameters.description: The Physical Layer (PHY) rate in {{units}} between this Interface and the Neighbor on this link that is estimated at this Interface.

parameters.name: RSSI
parameters.description: The estimated Received Signal Strength Indicator (RSSI) ratio in {{units}} between this Interface and the Neighbor on this link that is estimated at the receive side of this Interface. Note: This parameter is valid only for IEEE 802.11 Neighbors.

object.description: This object represents the metrics included in a Link metric response from the IEEE1905Device where {{param|#.LocalInterface}} is the MAC address of an interface in the receiving 1905 AL as defined in {{bibref|IEEE1905.1a|Table 6-17: 1905 transmitter link metric TLV}}.
